perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Solar builds. No Hesitation is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Solar builds and to synergise with the frame intrinsic, in the first trait perk column Physic applies Restoration ×1 for 5s (7.5s with Ember of Solace) to both the user and ally, when the support frame boost is triggered. Then, to help clear Minor add groups, Incandescent spreads +30 Solar Scorch stacks within 4m on a red bar Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with scorch damage counting as weapon damage so can inherit damage boosts, and also proc subclass fragments. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Dealer's Choice origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides an escalating bonus to super generation on a kill, depending on how many other Dealer's Choice weapons are equipped - with three, this is the fastest way bar none to generate super energy. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Solar builds. No Hesitation is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. To synergise with the frame intrinsic, in the first trait perk column Physic applies Restoration ×1 for 5s (7.5s with Ember of Solace on a Solar subclass) to both the user and ally, when the support frame boost is triggered. In the second column for damage, Chaos Reshaped stacks up to ×2 on dealing or receiving damage within a 5s window for at least 11.5s - at ×1 it provides a ×1.2 damage boost for a refreshable 7s and then at ×2 provides ×1.35 damage for a refreshable 7s together with a healing burst of up to 35HP that also starts health regeneration - although this is bugged, so while it's active it interrupts natural recovery and prevents regenerating the final 20-25% of your health bar. There's also Frenzy which after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s, until you're out of combat again. If you're running a Prismatic build, also worth considering is Elemental Honing which grants an escalating stack of damage up to max ×1.35 (elemental) for 23s for each elemental damage type inflicted, which can be refreshed with a new damage type until you've run through all 5. Aegis ranks the Dealer's Choice origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it provides an escalating bonus to super generation on a kill, depending on how many other Dealer's Choice weapons are equipped - with three, this is the fastest way bar none to generate super energy - on a Prismatic subclass with Elemental Supercharger (on Tablet of Ruin), the super generation in add phases is bonkers. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Rooty tooty gun go ... Healy? Our very first legendary support weapon. Subsistence and Incandescent will allow you to build up charges while still being able to clear rooms with ease. Leaning more into support you have new perks Physic and Circle of Life. One giving you better healing, while the latter giving you bonus damage after healing allies. Depending on how you expect to use No Hesitations combinations of those four perks could be very strong. Leaning more into healing your team, explosions, doing better damage, EXPLOSIONS. The choice is yours." Recommended MW: Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "No Hesitations is not going to be strong in PvP. Investing entirely into range puts you at a respectable 32m at 75 range. The third column perks let us down. No Zen Moment, Dynamic Sway Reduction, Tap the Trigger, or even Kill Clip leaves other autos high and mighty over No Hesitations." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 106 from 18 June 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0GYlriUxhFqNHGLqb84C1G?si=bb5a2c9b339d4c35) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor Spec enemies and fireteam support in end-game content, particularly with solar/prismatic fragments that boost healing. Shapeable. A new Support frame auto-rifle subtype that builds healing charges on enemy hits (there's a semi-circle below the reticule that fills up) which you can then hip fire at allies to heal them. Hitting six hipfire shots on an ally heals 12 health per hit, and starts x1 Restoration for 4s after 6 rapid hits. This also grants both Guardians a +10% "Support Frame boost" to damage for 5s, which stacks with every other damage buff source. No Hesitation is probably the strongest solar primary currently in the game, if you're in a fireteam. It's a bit weird to fire as it's not hitscan - but if you can get used to Osteo Striga's tracking shots, you'll do fine. First off, controller players might benefit from a bit of extra stability from the barrel and mag perks. The first and second trait column perks can double down on the frame intrinsic perks through Physic which grants x1 Restoration (x2 when enhanced) for 5s to both you and allies when procced, and Circle of Life which boosts damage on healing by an additional +25% for 10s (+37.5% total for the first 5s with the Support Frame Boost) for both you and the healed Guardian. The Dealer's Choice origin trait is nice to have (who doesn't love more super energy?) - with two or three Pale Heart weapons, you'll notice the difference! Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 106 from 18 June 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0GYlriUxhFqNHGLqb84C1G?si=bb5a2c9b339d4c35) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor Spec enemies and fireteam support in end-game content. Shapeable. A new Support frame auto-rifle subtype that builds healing charges on enemy hits (there's a semi-circle below the reticule that fills up) which you can then hip fire at allies to heal them. Hitting six hipfire shots on an ally heals 12 health per hit, and starts x1 Restoration for 4s after 6 rapid hits. This also grants both Guardians a +10% "Support Frame boost" to damage for 5s, which stacks with every other damage buff source. No Hesitation is probably the strongest solar primary currently in the game, if you're in a fireteam. It's a bit weird to fire as it's not hitscan - but if you can get used to Osteo Striga's tracking shots, you'll do fine. First off, controller players might benefit from a bit of extra stability from the barrel and mag perks. Demolitionist is great in the first trait column, but for grenade energy and instant reloads on a grenade throw, while Desperate Measures is very easy to proc with intrinsic for +10, +20 or +30% damage (+21, +32 or +43% when the frame intrinsic is also procced). The Dealer's Choice origin trait is nice to have (who doesn't love more super energy?) - with two or three Pale Heart weapons, you'll notice the difference! Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag mod.
